name: DePaul University Nursing Program Scheduling and Management System
description: A scheduling and management system for DePaul University's Nursing Department, enabling Program Administrators and Nursing Staff to manage nursing cohorts, curriculum structures, clinical and non-clinical classes, clinical site assignments, and student enrollments. The system tracks student progression, generates scheduling reports, reduces administrative errors and scheduling conflicts, and integrates with existing university systems. It provides automated notifications to students, instructors, and clinical site administrators regarding schedule changes and program updates.

name: Credit Card Dispute Management System for Representatives
description: A comprehensive system enabling cardmember and merchant services representatives to manage credit card dispute cases. The application supports creation and follow-up of disputes through ticket retrieval requests and chargebacks, tracks dispute status and history, and integrates with multiple backend systems to access transaction, cardmember, and merchant data. It generates correspondence and processes account adjustments, enforces role-based access controls, maintains complete audit trails, and ensures regulatory compliance while serving both internal and external users with appropriate data segregation.

name: Web-Based Recycled Parts and Repair Facility Management System
description: A web-based system supporting insurance claim adjusters and collision estimators in managing recycled parts sourcing and repair facility selection. The system integrates with an existing recycled parts database, enabling users to search for available recycled parts and locate preferred repair facilities based on vehicle location. Adjusters can audit recycled parts utilization within collision estimates and rate repair facilities based on their recycled parts performance. Designed for use in office and field environments, the application emphasizes ease of use, fast performance, role-based access control, and compliance with corporate standards and industry regulations.

name: Web-Based Conference Room and Meeting Management System
description: A web-based conference room and meeting management system for office environments, enabling employees to reserve conference rooms, schedule meetings, manage equipment, and receive notifications. Built on Java-based application servers, the system integrates with multiple database systems and email servers, and is accessible via standard web browsers. It supports multi-language localization, organizational branding customization, and accessibility compliance. The solution is designed for high availability, strong performance, and security, serving diverse user populations across various operating environments.

name: IzognMovies: African On-Demand Movie Streaming Platform
description: IzognMovies is a web-based streaming platform delivering African movies on demand to a global audience. Customers can register, browse, search, and purchase movies via credit card or pre-paid cards, streaming content within a 2-day viewing window. The platform supports subscription and pay-as-you-go monetization models. Administrators can manage movie catalogs, generate pre-paid cards, handle customer accounts, and access business analytics. A review functionality is also included. The design emphasizes accessibility for novice internet users through an African-inspired modern aesthetic, while maintaining robust security for customer and payment data.
